core_obligations: Set up the closures (proof lines 15779-15788): choose algebraic closures and the displayed square of fields; since k and k' are separably closed, the extensions to their algebraic closures are algebraic and purely inseparable.

Use topological invariance (proof lines 15789-15797): the morphisms X_kbar -> X and X_{k'bar} -> X_{k'} are then universal homeomorphisms, so the cohomology of F may be computed on X_kbar and that of F|_{X_{k'}} on X_{k'bar}.
Conclude (proof lines 15798-15801): the algebraically closed case applies to the pair of closures, and the two identifications transport it back to k and k'.
proof_roadmap: Pass to algebraic closures so that the extensions become purely inseparable.
Identify both cohomologies with those on the closure models by topological invariance.
Apply the algebraically closed case and transport back.
difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the invariance of etale cohomology of torsion sheaves on a proper curve from algebraically closed to separably closed base fields (statement lines 15768-15776). The proof (proof lines 15778-15801) passes to algebraic closures, uses pure inseparability and topological invariance to identify the two cohomologies with those on the closure models, and then applies the algebraically closed case. H2: one reduction through topological invariance.
